filter.referenced: typed Unsupported at <filter> element name offset (engine fail-closed)
filter.unreferenced: preserved untouched, subset shapes published, no filter published

mask.referenced: typed Unsupported at <mask> element (planner returns offset 0 for group owners; engine remaps to the element)

pattern.referenced: Decoder suspends with NeedPattern; finish rejected; failed render resumes as typed error; never success (no renderer in scope)

marker.referenced: typed Unsupported at <marker> element (engine fail-closed; decoder+planner can expand markers but output is not subset-verified)

image.referenced: typed Unsupported at <image> element (pre-existing engine test)

gradients: linear gradient through cached-paint path publishes (pre-existing engine test); not otherwise expanded
use: decodes (shape published); not subset-verified beyond no-panic
css_style_selectors: decodes without panic, source preserved; selector application not verified
smil_animation: decodes without panic, source preserved; animation not rendered
external_references: typed Unsupported at the url(http...) value offset inside the host element
unknown_rendered_elements: typed Unsupported at the element; unknown elements inside metadata/defs and known editor namespaces (sodipodi/inkscape) are preserved source-only
silent_drop_or_success: none observed in the cases above
